# Vocabulary

Read from [`ontology/ogham-amt.ttl`](https://github.com/LinkedOpenOgham/tei--epidoc-amt/blob/main/ontology/ogham-amt.ttl).

| Term | Kind | Meaning | What it does not say |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ogham:Inscription` | Concept | One inscription on a monument whose record describes several (Blackwaterfoot 1 has two with a reading). It exists only for those records: for a record with one inscription, the stone stands for it. | Not a text: the text is the reading. Readings of different inscriptions are not alternatives of each other, so their weights are computed within the inscription. |
| `ogham:OghamStone` | Concept | A monument that carries an ogham inscription, as one OG(H)AM EpiDoc file describes it. Identified by its CIIC number, or by the name of its record where it has none. |  |
| `ogham:Reading` | Concept | One transliteration of the inscription: either the current edition of the OG(H)AM team or a historical reading from the apparatus of the EpiDoc file. |  |
| `ogham:hasReading` | Role | The stone, or its inscription where the record has several, is read this way by an editor. Each statement carries the weight of that reading among the readings of the same stone or inscription. range `Reading`. | Does not say that the reading is correct, and does not say which editor is more reliable: the weight is the normalised product of reading confidence and tradition agreement (rule v1). It has no inverse, because a share among alternatives is directional. The subject is an ogham:OghamStone, or an ogham:Inscription in a record with several inscriptions; a formal domain is left out for that reason. |
| `ogham:hasInscription` | Link | The monument carries this inscription. Written only for records with several inscriptions. Domain `OghamStone`, range `Inscription`. | Carries no weight and is not an amt:Role: nothing is shared out among inscriptions. |
| `ogham:ConfidenceAgreementRule` | Method | Weight of a reading among the readings of one stone: the reading confidence c(r) (from the doubt markup of the reading) times the tradition agreement a(r) (the share of readings that cluster with it), divided by the sum of these products over all readings of the stone. Four decimals. | Formula: `c(r) * a(r) / sum(c * a)` |

## Terms of the Fuzziness-Wobbliness ontology that the graphs use

| Term | Used for |
|---|---|
| `fw:hasType` | The factor that lowered the weight (one of the three types below) |
| `fw:Vagueness`, `fw:Uncertainty`, `fw:FuzzinessWobbliness` | The three types of AMT.engine 0.6.0 |
| `fw:hasMethod` | The rule that produced the weight |
| `fw:derivedFrom`, `fw:TextEvidence`, `fw:sourceString` | The text of the reading the weight was derived from |
